Marked no-dsa by Debian Security Team; see https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2025-10911

This is not security vulnerability. The xslt random function provided by libxslt does not offer any security or cryptography guarantees. Applications using libxslt that rely on non-repeatable randomness should be seeding the system PRNG (srand()) themselves, as they would if calling rand() directly.
